title: Grateful Dead Live at Madison Square Garden on 1983-10-11
source: flac16/48kHz; Jim Wise's Master Audience Cassettes; Beyer M160 mics > Sony TC-D5 (Maxell UDXLII C90)(located at the soundboard)Transfer Info:Master Cassettes (Nakamichi Dragon)> Tascam DA-3000 (DSF 1-bit/5.6 MHz) > dBpoweramp (24-bit/96 kHz) > Adobe Audition 3.01 (24-bit/96 kHz) > TLH flac2496; 24-bit > 16-bit via dBpoweramp

ai_review.summary: Crisp audience recording captures a high‑energy show highlighted by St. Stephen, Jack Straw, Birdsong and a rocking Bertha run.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the electric atmosphere of this concert, citing standout performances of St. Stephen, Jack Straw, Birdsong, Bertha and China Doll, with the second set especially “rockin.” The audience tape is praised for its surprisingly clear and full sound, making the show easy to enjoy despite being a non‑soundboard source.

ai_rating.rationale: Two detailed, high‑scoring reviews emphasize an exceptional performance and a surprisingly clear audience recording, leading to a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the tape as amazingly crisp and full with great energy from both band and crowd; no major flaws reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set highlighted by Jack Straw and Birdsong; second set stepped up with a powerful pre‑drums run (especially Bertha) and high‑energy renditions throughout.

band_member_comments.Phil: Phil sang lead on China Doll, an unusual occurrence at the time.
band_member_comments.Drums: Pre‑drums run described as rocking, indicating strong drum work.
